projectDescription: Rivlo is a social fitness app for walks, runs, and hikes that turns everyday movement into progress through leagues, clubs, Club Wars, widgets, and RIVO — an AI-powered activity coach.
keyFeatures: Step, run, and hike tracking with daily goals and streaks
Clubs — create or join teams of up to 50 members
Club Wars — live head-to-head competitive step battles between clubs
War Tickets — entry currency for Club Wars
Leagues — six-tier progression from Rookie to Immortal
RIVO — AI-powered activity coach (Rivlo Intelligence Virtual Object)
Home Screen Widgets for steps, league status, and activity
Customizable themes (Rivlo Blue, Dark, Monochrome, Gold, Sunfire)
Rivlo Pro — advanced insights, ad-free, exclusive themes and badge
Run and hike tracking with GPS, pace, elevation, and route mapping
